Ian Xiao, Example 3.4 [ex:dot-in-one-block], p. 11. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. Zero-based Fin 4 labels encode the paper’s {1,2} as {0,1} and its (2 3) as the swap of 1 and 2. The source subgroup fixes the complement of the block pointwise, and the target is all of S₄. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
